data.title: Can Elon Musk really put AI datacentres in space? - The Latest
data.description: The Trump administration has approved Elon Musk’s plan to launch one million satellites into orbit to create datacentres in space. SpaceX argues the project could reduce the impact of datacentres on Earth as the AI industry grows. But how realistic is the plan and what could the consequences be? Michael Safi speaks to Guardian global technology editor Dan Milmo
